name: [BALANCE UPD] FIRE FORCE REIGNITION
desc:
Try fighting fire with fire!
CODE: KNIGHTKING

[ Basic Controls ]
SHIFT/Double-Tap W = Run
Q = Dash
M1 = Light Attack
M2 = Heavy Attack
Run + Jump + M1 = Aerial Attack
Slide + M1 = Entry Attack
Slide + M2 = Entry Guardbreak
Jump + M2 = Ground Slam
F = Block
F + M1 = Counter
E = Deflect
TAB = Equip Weapon
B = Execute
V = Carry
M = Menu
U = Toggle Map Locations 
P = Toggle Party
